verdict.rationale: Clerk documents an official CLI (clerk.com/cli, referenced also in llms.txt: 'Install the Clerk CLI to add auth to your app') and a first-party agent skill file that explicitly invokes the CLI for setup, showing it's built for AI-native/agentic workflows. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of CLI usage and richer documentation of CLI command surface beyond install/quickstart.
